messages:
ali (CS): FYI Equinox dedicated pool bring-up moved to Thu 09:15 PT. Need a short smoke, final quota window, and a plan for a potential burst import 75m in. Can SRE/infra confirm?

brett (SRE): We can own watch. Suggested ramp: 6m priming -> 8m @20% -> 12m @50% -> 25m soak at target. Autoscale triggers: cpu_95>0.92 or queue_ms>1600 for 2m to scale up; scale down after 9m below 60%.

xiang (Infra): Add KV prefix priming (4m) before the ramp to avoid cold prefixes. We'll pin inference model to eqx-2.0-quant for the first 24h. Also suggest limiting concurrent long-context sessions to 6 for the first 90m.

tara (Solutions): Equinox ops requests: embeddings route capped to 110 rps for first 60m and a dashboard link for live metrics. They will do a short smoke at 09:35 PT. Also they'll do a burst import at +75m and will notify 15m prior.

ali (CS): @xiang confirm model pin and concurrency cap? @brett add embeddings throttle to the autoscale doc? I'll tell Equinox to hold imports until signaled.

xiang (Infra): Confirmed: model pinned eqx-2.0-quant for 24h. Long-context concurrency limited to 6 via proxy. Fallback model staged eqx-1.9-fp16 in control plane.

brett (SRE): Patching autoscale snippet in ticket (CS-6011):

```
{"scale_up":{"cond":"cpu_95>0.92 or queue_ms>1600","window":"2m"},"scale_down":{"cond":"cpu_5<0.6","window":"9m"},"burst":{"factor":1.8,"duration":"4m","enabled_window":"first_120m"},"embeddings_temp_quota":"110rps","limits":{"min":4,"max":180}}
```

ali (CS): Nice. Who triggers the smoke?

ops-bot: Ticket CS-6011 created: Equinox dedicated bring-up orchestration. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-6011

tara (Solutions): I'll trigger the smoke and coordinate with Equinox SRE. Plan: 40 synthetic users, mixed chat+embed, 6m. Smoke slated for 09:35 PT.

brett (SRE): For smoke generation recommend this quick script (mixed load):

```
for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"route":"chat","prompt":"healthcheck"}'; curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"ping"}'; sleep 0.6; done
```

ali (CS): Rollback criteria I'll publish in the runbook: sustained error rate >5% for 10m OR p95 latency > 3s for 12m. Who has final rollback authority?

brett (SRE): SRE has rollback authority; infra can flip fallback model. We'll coordinate on the call.

xiang (Infra): Control-plane toggle ready, fallback model warmed. I'll add a sticky note in CS-6011.

ali (CS): EOD checklist: 1) brett paste autoscale + rollback to CS-6011, 2) xiang add model pin + fallback, 3) tara coordinate smoke + confirm customer hold, 4) I'll send customer runbook and timeline.

tara (Solutions): Confirmed. Equinox will hold imports until post-green. I'll post confirmation to the ticket.

brett (SRE): Autoscale snippet posted to CS-6011.

xiang (Infra): Model pin and fallback notes added.

ali (CS): Thanks team 1: will post final ack to Equinox channel when they confirm. :white_check_mark:
